diagnosis: Recent no-allocation receipts encoded explicit CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED boundaries in heterogeneous fields. build-fast-allocator's first-pass filter inspected only reason/outcome, while multiple current receipts carry the value in classification. Those refs therefore survived into GUIDE_RESCATE LOW_YIELD evidence, contradicting already-ratcheted EFF016B/EFF017 and turning non-repairable connector safety boundaries into apparent software repair debt.
intervention: Extended the existing role-evidence-integrity owner instead of adding a new coordination layer. GUIDE_RESCATE/LOW_YIELD evidence now recognizes CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED in reason, outcome, classification or code; such refs remain machine-visible as telemetry-only diagnostics but are removed from candidate and immutable claim_payload_shape evidence. A rescate whose only usable evidence is explicit transport denial is suppressed. Actionable no-allocation, recovery, collision and other valid evidence remain unchanged.
expected_multiplicative_effect: Prevents repeated Guide rescue capacity from being spent on connector safety boundaries that cannot be repaired by repository work, while preserving real low-yield signals and the existing worker ABI. This reduces false rescue pressure without adding worker reads, queues or schedulers.
